CONSTITUTION.intent: Revise the project's AGENTS.md (constitution) as a general tidy-up: review the current toolchain table, judgment boundaries and ADR conventions, and propose improvements that make the directives clearer, non-redundant, accurate to the codebase and accepted ADRs, and checkable where possible. Keep the four Quality Gate commands (ADR-0003) intact.
CONSTITUTION.summary: No change to the directives: the two Judgment Boundaries are already short, distinct and need an agent's judgment, so the tidy-up keeps them word for word, which the guardrails in SPEC-0001 to SPEC-0003 also require. The Toolchain table, with its four ADR-0003 Quality Gate commands, and the ADR Conventions section belong to the human and to land_conventions, so this review does not edit them.
directives: Every external dependency requires a documented rationale in SPECs or ADRs.
